thread:
kevin: Heads up — planning to push Python and TS SDKs (2.4.1) to canary in the 09:00-10:00 UTC change window. This includes an async-only client rename and a packaging fix for wheels. Monitoring requested.

deploy-bot: publish job queued (job_id: pj_89012). Will post updates when uploads start.

pkg-bot: npm publish started for @redwood/inference@2.4.1-canary. pypi upload started for redwood-inference 2.4.1rc0 (wheel + sdist). Logs: uploading wheels -> ok -> awaiting classifiers.

maya: Running integration smoke — TS client auth header tests failing:
```
TypeError: client.setAuthHeader is not a function
 at tests/auth.test.ts:42:12
```

sam: Oof. Is that the rename we changed? Should we yank the canary and rollback to 2.4.0 until we patch?

anna: I think so — recommend pinning stable in docs and quickstarts until we have a patched canary. Suggested commands to recommend to customers: `pip install redwood-inference==2.4.0` and `npm i @redwood/inference@2.4.0`.

kevin: Agreed. Plan: yank the canary from public channels, roll back routing for hosted bundles, and open a 2.4.1-hotfix branch. We'll cut a fixed 2.4.1-rc2 to canary once tests pass. Also need release notes calling out the breaking rename and a migration snippet.

pkg-bot: npm unpublish @redwood/inference@2.4.1-canary -> done. pypi: yanked redwood-inference 2.4.1rc0. Tagged 2.4.0 as latest-stable on npm.

deploy-bot: Rollback started for CDN + hosted SDK bundles. Canary CDN routes removed, traffic shifted to 2.4.0.

sophie: I'll update the changelog entry and add a migration guide section showing `new RedwoodClient({ ... })` -> `await Redwood.createClient({ ... })` and note the old sync methods will be deprecated in the next minor.

anna: I'll patch the quickstart templates to pin 2.4.0 and add a prominent in-console banner pointing to the migration guide.

kevin: Timeline: merge fix branch, run CI, republish 2.4.1-rc2 to canary on Wed 14:00 UTC if green. If smoke + canary checks pass, promote to stable Thu change window. Any blockers?

sam: sgtm from infra side. I'll own the canary checks and smoke test run.

pkg-bot: Noted — will hold off on stable tag until explicit promote command.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed at 1765004382. CDN and hosted routes are back on 2.4.0.

kevin: Thanks all — follow-up: put a short postmortem note in #eng-releases with timeline + root cause once we confirm the root cause of the type mismatch.

maya: A quick note — root cause likely a TS export rename introduced in the packaging change. I'll open a PR with the minimal shim + tests.

kevin: Perfect. We'll re-run the canary after that.
